name: Shenanigans & Shine
description: Shenanigans is a lively karaoke bar and restaurant that offers an engaging and fun-filled karaoke experience. Known for its fantastic atmosphere, friendly staff, and great food and drinks, it hosts karaoke every Friday and live music on Saturdays, making it a vibrant spot for entertainment. The venue stands out with its welcoming vibe, quality sound system, and a diverse song selection, creating an inviting environment for both casual and dedicated karaoke enthusiasts.
